title: Seed new workspaces with a welcome file
reason: Requests an editable welcome canvas for newly created tldraw.com workspaces. This is a product onboarding feature for the upstream workspace service, with no comments available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve-specific implementation or reproduction was inspected; the request is upstream workspace onboarding scope.

title: Stray line connects palm touch point to stylus when switching into pen mode on iPad
reason: Reports a stroke joining an earlier palm contact to a newly detected stylus on iPad. This needs real stylus/palm input evidence to distinguish browser pointer-capture behavior from application state; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve device reproduction was performed; do not infer a Varve defect from the upstream report.

title: Vec's z component is semantically overloaded, letting unrelated meanings leak between APIs
reason: Discusses pressure and zoom sharing a generic vector z component in the upstream SDK, including whether the default should be zero or one. No comments were available, and the type contract is specific to that SDK.

varveAssessment.assessment: No analogous Varve type defect was identified from this upstream report; no source change is justified without a local contract or reproduction.

title: Add presence indicators to workspace files in the sidebar
reason: Requests colored active-user indicators and an overflow count on workspace file rows. It depends on upstream workspace-level presence aggregation and is a feature request rather than a standalone editor defect.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's collaboration presence is stubbed and no workspace presence service is established; no implementation was inferred from this request.

title: Avoid recalculating freehand geometries during resize
reason: The comment links a proposed PR and enumerates assumptions about invalidation paths for cached freehand bounds. This is an upstream profiling and cache-coherency investigation, not evidence of a Varve regression.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve resize profile was collected for this report; any geometry-cache change would require workload benchmarks and invalidation regressions.

title: Accessibility audit: WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA gaps in the SDK and tldraw.com
reason: The detailed report audits upstream SDK and tldraw.com; maintainers dispute some findings as misunderstanding existing canvas accessibility, while a follow-up separates actionable items from false positives and migration-dependent changes.

varveAssessment.assessment: The upstream audit is not a substitute for Varve's own accessibility evidence; no local findings were verified in this assessment.

title: Commits created during rebase bypass the local formatting check
reason: Identifies that rebase-created commits may bypass upstream pre-commit formatting checks and proposes a later gate. It is repository maintenance process, not a Varve user-facing defect.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve hook change is justified by the upstream repository's local formatting workflow.

title: Clicking into a text shape on a link edits the link instead of the text
reason: Reports difficulty placing a text caret when a text shape contains a link. The sole reply calls the behavior an intentional trade-off and invites ideas; no agreed fix is recorded.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve reproduction was performed; treat as a UX regression-test lead only if local linked-text editing shows the same ambiguity.

title: Alt-cloning mid-drag reverts unrelated changes made during the drag
reason: Reports switching an active selection drag into clone mode restoring the drag-start document and discarding intervening document changes. This is an upstream interaction transaction bug; no discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve reproduction or equivalent implementation path was verified from this report.

title: Object and dict validators accept arrays
reason: Documents JavaScript arrays passing upstream @tldraw/validate object/dictionary validators and links a spec-driven test PR. A search of Varve packages found no equivalent validator APIs, so this report does not identify an analogous local defect.

varveAssessment.assessment: Searched packages for unknownObject and dict validator APIs; no matching validation library or call sites were found.
